name: countdown
author: CVER Inc.
calls: GET <data-src> — only for a root that carries `data-src`, and then the bundle's only network call: one fetch per such root, sent once on load, with no request body and no header other than `Accept: application/json`; the browser's default credential behaviour for that URL applies. A root without `data-src` makes no network call at all. The response is read as an events feed (`{ events: [...] }`); a non-ok response, a network failure, a body that is not JSON, and a feed with no event the root can count to are all handled the same way — see `without`.
without: requires nothing. A root without `data-src` calls nothing: without the script it stays exactly as authored — an author who marked it `hidden` sees nothing, otherwise the host's own markup shows with empty unit elements — and a `data-deadline` without an explicit offset is treated the same way: nothing is mounted and nothing is changed. A root with `data-src` whose feed is unreachable, or holds no event it can count to (none still ahead, or only all-day and floating events with no `data-offset` on the root), counts to its `data-deadline` when it has a valid one and is otherwise left exactly as authored; its `data-event` and `data-event-href` elements keep the host's own text and links.
